    # Custom rectangular profile (80 wide x 60 tall) expressed in sketch-local

    # about X: the 60mm profile dimension becomes the world Z extent and the

    # sits at X:-40..40, Y:20..30 (outer face at Y=+30, inner face at Y=+20) and
    # Z:0..60.  This overlaps the base (Y 20..30, Z 0..10) so the union forms a
    # single clean 90-degree bend at the rear (+Y) edge of the base.
    _plate_prism = extrude(sk_vertical_plate_profile, amount=THICKNESS)
    solid_1 = Pos(0.0, 30.0, 0.0) * Rot(X=90) * _plate_prism
    _measure_feature(solid_1, 'step-02-extrude-vertical-plate', 'extrude')

    _measure_feature(solid_0, 'step-01-extrude-base-plate-union-target', 'union_operand_a')
